results.title: Parakeet AI Review 2026: Is It Worth It and Is It Safe?
results.content:
To Parakeet's credit, it replied to this one the next day, suggesting a setup problem and pointing to the tutorials and free sessions. That responsiveness is new since July, when the negative reviews sat unanswered. Trustpilot currently records that the company has replied to 25% of its negative reviews.

#### What users like

 Simple to set up and start
 Good transcription, even with accents
 Fine for behavioral and general tech chat
 Credits that do not expire
 A genuinely long free trial
 Support now replies to complaints

#### What users complain about

 Answers freezing or making no sense
 Weak on deep coding problems
 Refunds refused, charges after canceling
 Billing rounds up to the half hour
 Code so complex it invites follow-up questions
 Screen sharing still getting flagged [...] > "When the first credit expired, the whole thing froze and I had to click a button to continue the session. This happened right in the middle of me reading a solution, and the entire answer window basically disappeared until I hit continue."Blind user, Software Engineering Career, December 2025

Worse, that moment seems to have broken the tool's hiding:

> "The instant I had to manually activate that second credit, something changed. After that, every time I clicked anything inside Parakeet AI, the IDE reacted as if I had clicked away from it... I was being notified that I left the IDE for x number of minutes."Blind user, Software Engineering Career, December 2025 [...] By 18 September 2026, the same profile reads 4.4 out of 5 from 54 reviews, with 74% of them five star. On the face of it, that is a dramatic turnaround in two months, and the honest reading is that some of it is real: the product did improve, and the company now replies to complaints, which it did not do before.

But the number needs an asterisk, and we found it in Parakeet's own documentation. Buried in the privacy section of its FAQ, in a list of which AI providers process user data, is this line:

> "Reviewing us for free credits: the screenshot you upload goes to Google, or OpenAI if that model is unavailable, to check the review is published and yours."ParakeetAI official FAQ, privacy section, September 2026
